importantFindings: Handbollsligan's 23 Jun preseason guide contains a 19-player roster. Skånela then officially added Jesper Filén on 31 Jul on a two-year contract, producing a current verified snapshot of 20 players.
The club's generic Herrar A page still says 'Truppen säsongen 2025/2026'; it was used for dated 2026 news announcements, not as a 2026/27 roster list.
Henrik Smedby is explicitly listed by Handbollsligan as leaving for IK Bolton despite an older Skånela contract announcement that could otherwise be misread as covering 2026/27.
Alexander Ritter is explicitly V9/M9 in Skånela's signing announcement. Handbollsligan places him under M9, therefore M9 is primary and V9 is a VERIFIED secondary position.
Skånela's Isac Axelsson announcement contains both spellings Isac and Isak. The Handbollsligan roster uses Isac; canonical fullName is Isac Axelsson and Isak Axelsson is retained as an alias.
Jesper Filén's V6 position is supported by official Handbollsligan statistics from 2025/26; the 31 Jul Skånela return announcement establishes current membership.
All current shirt numbers remain null because a verified 2026/27 shirt-number list was not found.
